title: Library Antics for ST
description: After a hostile teacher assigns him library detention, John brings an ancestral grimoire and attempts to turn the tables with magic. The resulting branching story mixes school drama, mystery, transformations, identity changes, and increasingly chaotic supernatural consequences.
description_html:
Library Antics
Spoiler:
By ZeBeste






Synopsis

After agitating his teacher Jack yet again, John is issued a detention to be served in the library. Convinced that Jack has ulterior motives for giving him a detention alone in the library and on the urging from his friend Katrina, John finds himself in a life changing experience when he decides to bring his ancestor's grimoire, a book filled with spells culminated over many generations, with him in order to put an end to Jack's harassment. Needless to say, things don't entirely go according to plan.


Flowchart
Spoiler:
Writer's Note
Library Antics features several custom characters, backgrounds, additional expressions not native to Student Transfer and a new outfit for John. Fortunately, they will not overwrite any preexisting files and therefore cause any issues with your Student Transfer installation

Changelog (by update release date)

Initial Release - 9/03/2017

The initial teaser to set expectations for what is to come. Contains the foundations for two separate routes. Should take around roughly 20 to 30 minutes to read.

Version 1.01 - 9/15/2017
Relatively minor update that has more content to the twinning route along with a few much needed adjustments here and there. New content should take around 10 minutes to read.

Completely rewrote the transformation sequences and significantly revised every scene with Katrina except for one.

Added custom character CGs for Katrina and Maria.

Fixed several typos and grammar mistakes.

Version 1.5 - 9/30/2017 - 241kb

I've just about to managed to fulfill my promise of releasing a significant update monthly with this one. The word count has since doubled from 20,000 to 40,000. This update also uses custom character art, which is why two .py files are included. Again as before, you'll want to extract the contents of the .zip file into your "game" directory

Unfortunately for those that were looking forward to more content with Katrina and Sayaka, you'll have to hold out for just a little bit longer! All of the new content stems entirely from a single path in the Maria path, when you decide to "Continue watching Jack." From there and after some unfortunate events, you will eventually reach three different choices.

One of these choices leads to a "bad" end, one that I'm not completely finished writing yet. As for the other two... well, you'll see.


Version 2.0 - 2/1/2018 - 494kb

Finally after 4 months, 2.0 is finally out! The Student Transfer Developer team graciously bundled it and distributed with the main v3 release so there's no need for a download link! I not only rewrote and revised much of the dialogue, and added a great deal of content to the Sayaka and Jane branch. I will elaborate later... once I'm fully finished with reading all of v3.

Version 3.0 - 10/9/2019 - 678kb

Even I'm having difficulty believing it took nearly 2 years for me to get this crucial update ready for release, far longer than I had anticipated. I have heavily revised much of the introduction and clearing out much of the purple prose that plagued it, so you may find it worth rereading the game from the very beginning if you haven't already played Library Antics for v3. As the title of the thread indicates, you will need to play this version with the latest version of Student Transfer which as of today is v4.5 as the scenario features character expressions that are only available there.

title: The K-Files
description:
The K-Files


Plot:
John bails on Kiyoshi's alien-hunting expedition, with Kyoko taking his place. The two decide that aliens gave them the remote so they could investigate the unexplained mysteries of planet Earth. Hijinks ensue.

Author Ramblings:
If you came here looking for fap material... sorry. The K-Files is close to being painfully PG. I'm just as disappointed as you are. Also, there aren't any (meaningful) choices. Sorry, again.

What it does have to offer is one complete story thread. There aren't any forks because I don't want to taunt people with a bunch of dead ends that may never get filled in. Consider this a bottle episode from an alternate ST universe.

Any and all feedback is appreciated, as this scenario is basically me experimenting with and trying to learn about both writing and Ren'py.

Installation Instructions:
Download the .rpy file and drop it into your Student Transfer scenarios folder.

title: Spitting Image
description:
Spitting Image


Plot:
After John learns a spell that can change him into anyone he knows, Kat talks him into taking a picture of "Sayaka" and Kiyoshi as a couple. Things go downhill for John from there.

Author Notes:
After K-Files, I thought I'd try something a little more ambitious. Or maybe a lot more ambitious. The goal with Spitting Image is to have a little bit more sexiness and a whole lot more choice than K-Files did. Also a bigger cast and a much less rushed ending.

That said, this is a partial release. The last day is currently a mess, what with the diverging paths, so I decided to cut it off and release the story so far in hopes of soliciting some feedback. Most of the payoff for your choices occurs on the last day so your experience will be fairly linear, though not as linear as K-Files.

As before, any and all feedback is welcome. Tell me what you liked, or better yet tell me what you hated. Tell me what you'd like to see on the last day of the scenario too, if you have any thoughts on that. Or just tell me that I screwed up because it's broken.

Installation Instructions:
Download the .zip file and extract its contents into your Student Transfer folder. The password is "kiymaster".

description: A rough-edged five-day game-jam collection following John, Yoko, and their friends through body swaps, identity confusion, karaoke, and literary-club banter.
description_html:
Odds and Ends



So I took a small break from writing the main game due to writer's block. To stay productive I had a small game jam of just me over this last weekend. It is still a bit rough around the edges, such as there's only two spots with music, but I wanted to keep myself to the about 56 hours I had. Regardless, I hope it's as fun to read as it was to write.

Let me know what you think.

ST V3: https://mega.nz/#!hYUH0YrI!_KlH7K_Z3QBT ... PvYxJUSDNw
ST V4.1: https://mega.nz/#!VJ0S3ahQ!IDLUiLDmwsfS ... GXRMlJIgOM

So we've had some discussion on the discord, and I think it merits saving, albeit under spoilers.
Spoiler:
Day 1
Spoiler The game only ever followed John. Day one John thought he was Yoko.
I love unreliable narration.
Grizz wrote:How much of the original john is still there? or has yokos perception of him ruined him?
So how I'm running it. Yoko is erasing specific memories but John remembers anything not targeted. For example he remembers that clothes don't mean you have sex on the train with strangers.
The personality changes via remote are reversed but similarly he'll subconsciously remember his preferences from those days.
Such that he might entertain the idea of karaoke since he's enjoyed it twice.
ShadowVA wrote: so pretty much if the days went on, John would have been molded into Yoko, just with a few traces of his own personality. like his choice in songs being the "geek kind" instead of Yoko's preferred taste
Hmm... He would probably be much closer to her personality than he is now, which is her goal, but the way she mind control him he wouldn't be interested in some things regardless.
For example, since it's not going to happen, since Yoko has one outfit...
If he went clothes shopping as her, that's not something he'd actually enjoy without more direct mind control.
Of which Yoko is trying to avoid. She's really trying to get him to come out of his shell on his own terms.
Additional Pylons wrote:does the book or whatever (codex?) has any plot relevance?
Spoiler:
YES! If I ever continue this, you better believe that book is more important than just a thing for John to do.

title: Always Get the Warranty
description: A fragile alien device throws John and a large cast of students, staff, and family members into a sprawling series of body swaps, possessions, identity conflicts, and reality-altering mishaps, with numerous choices and endings.
description_html:
Alright so my first scenario, first big creative writing endeavor, man this is pretty exciting for something so small. As is it's sort of a narrative ramble, not too many choices, no one path is particularly long, but I enjoyed/am enjoying writing this so maybe someone else will too. Currently there are 10 completed endings out of what will be an estimated 30-ish. If you play it and feel like sharing some thoughts/feedback go right ahead.

Tips and Warnings:
-Sometimes not making a choice is a choice. If a decision menu seems to be written as if time is short not clicking something is not only a valid option, but some of the endings currently in are only doable this way.

-If it seems like something has been randomly decided for you, it probably has. Try rolling back before a jump and saving to reload and find the other routes.

-I have a very particular fetish that I write for, and I realize that it won't be for everyone. That fetish is never writing any explicit sexual content. Just warning you if it's not your thing.

-If you happen to look into the script itself you might find some goofs and wip notes I hid in there.

-Be prepared for a monstrous number of commas.

Oh also this is my first time I've hosted anything on MEGA, so let me know if something is wrong.

title: Remote Possibilities
description:
Remote Possibilities


Overview

Remote Possibilities is a 'What if' scenario where john does not come into the possession of the remote and it instead falls to some unknown student in the school. But the player still plays as John and now has little to no control over what happens as they instead attempt to figure out who's behind the craziness, or just get swept along for the ride. As time passes and the culprit becomes more brazen and experienced, things will escalate - becoming wilder and darker.

Current themes are:
-Body Swap
-Mental changes
-Mind control
-Twinning
-Personality overwriting




Now V6 Compatible

Download link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sCEeYP ... sp=sharing


Version 1.2.1:

It's been three years but I've picked this up again. This update adds the continuation of the Cornelia and Sayaka routes, with all routes going equally (with the exception of Rita's due to me not wanting to spoil her character in the main game) now going to the end of the first day, it's around 28500 lines and probably about 4-5 hours long. I also went back and fixed a ton of animation, some janky dialogue, spelling and grammatical errors.

Based on popular demand I've removed the RNG for the new paths.



Future Plans

I'm going to pick this up again at a leisurely pace. Writing a half day at each time. Of course, more routes means exponential growth, so I'm not sure how large I'll make each update. I'll most likely do the "Standard" route first.



Feedback is very much appreciated.

title: The Gift Of Switching
description:
Overview: John and Kiyoshi wake one day to find they've been given an incredible gift: a remote that allows then to switch bodies at will. Instead of keeping it a secret, they immediately let their friends in on the fun. What happens after leads then down many different paths of chaos.


Author's Notes:
Hello all! So I've been working on this off and on for about a year now. I originally wrote the Body Switchers scenario but didn't like there it was going. Giving John and Kiyoshi the power to switch limited my options so I basically started from the ground up and gave them a remote this time (yes, original, I know, but it works!) Some of you will recognize parts from Body Switchers carried over to this one. Some stuff was taken out all together and a whole bunch of new stuff was thrown in. 

It's still very rough around the edges. Some scenes don't have animation and some parts are quick filler I added so I could get a release out for the long Memorial Day weekend  There's only one path that makes it all the way to Day 2. This was my first time really tying several paths together so hopefully it worked out in the end. I'm sure there are a ton of spelling errors than I missed but I got the bulk of them before release.

Thanks and hope you enjoy!

title: Yui Spellbook - Continuation of the main story (v
description: A large continuation of Yui’s spellbook route in which John and Yui explore transformation, possession, cloning, and other forms of magic across numerous branching storylines. Several branches reach endings, while others remain unfinished.
description_html:
Yui Spellbook continuation
By Applemelon

This scenario is based on the spellbook -> possess Yui branch. I've tried to keep it as close to the canon as possible, but took a few liberties to expand upon it as well.

There are currently 5 endings.

This scenario is not compatible with any v4 versions of the game and likely won't be for some time. Please install this on the v3.1 version of the game.

[[Download link]]

How to install:
Through the Install Scenario option:
1. Download the file above
2. Press "Install Scenario" in the scenario menu of the game.
3. Select the downloaded file.

Manual:
1. Download the file above
2. Extract the file inside the .zip file in the download link.
3. Place it in the scenario folder, which can be found in your main Student Transfer folder under game/scenario.

BEFORE YOU PLAY!

Remember not to have the previous version installed at the same time as the current version!

If you are playing Student Transfer scenarios, it is a good idea to keep as few scenarios installed as possible, especially when you have multiple large scenarios installed. So if you encounter any errors during your playthrough, make sure you try solving it by having this scenario as the only installed scenario.

You do not need any other scenarios or character packs in order to play this scenario. It is completely stand-alone and should not cause any errors with other scenarios.

Please be aware that this scenario is quite large compared to other scenarios. As such, expect it to take up about ~140MB of space on your drive.

Flowchart of the scenario paths:

This flowchart contains heavy spoilers! Read only if you want to figure out what you might be missing!
Spoiler:
To other scenario developers:
Spoiler:
Installing this scenario brings a lot of assets with it. However! That doesn't mean you should redirect people to install my scenario just so that they can use assets unique to this scenario!

Be sure to check your own scenario and import the assets found here into your own folders. Your scenario should never require this scenario to be installed.

title: Hunting The Witch Hunter Ver 0.5.2
description: John becomes trapped in a repeating four-day cycle after a witch hunter poisons him. Players investigate suspects, learn spells, brew potions, adopt disguises, and pursue multiple endings while searching for the antidote.
description_html:
Hello everyone, Kat-Box here!

I was working on a completely different scenario before this one but I was feeling pretty uninspired. I was taking a break from writing that story and became inspired again by a game I was playing. I’ve been working hard on this one for a few weeks now. I will be leaving town for a while and wanted to post something to the forum before I left. This is not the final product more than likely and the story is difficult to write due to the way it is structured so there may be a lot of errors. If you do get errors, or something happens that doesn’t seem like it should be happening please let me know because I may have time to fix some small problems before I leave. If you have suggestions on how to improve this scenario in any way I am always willing to take suggestions.

Story: John discovers that he is a warlock but the fun is cut short when a witch hunter poisons him. Using his trusty magical amulet John has created a time loop and is reliving the same four days forever. Will you be able to help John solve the mystery and retrieve the antidote?

Content: There are currently 4 spells to cast, 5 disguises to use, 3 potions to brew, 3 witch hunters to catch, one of which will be chosen at random when the scenario starts, and 5 endings to see, 2 bad endings and 3 good.

Cheating: If you are a dirty cheater like me or you keep getting the same witch hunter and want to be able check who the hunter is before you start playing you can go into the story folder and edit the file hunting.rpy, near the top you will see $ cheats = False change it to $ cheats = True. This will allow you to cheat. Cheating lets you see who the witch hunter is, unlock all magic, unlock all disguises, go to sleep at any time, give yourself items, and a few other random useless things. The scenario was not made with cheating in mind so it could cause some unexpected issues.

Flow Charts: I realized that this scenario isn't super easy to figure out because there are very few hints and clues on how to do things. (Also my poor writing skill may play a part in why it is hard to find the endings. ) As a result I have decided to make some really crappy flow charts on how to get to the endings. I think I included all the info that you will need.

title: A place in the world
description:
Hello there!

I started to play Student Transfer months ago and the scenario function surprised me a lot: ton of new content at disposal and a solid base game.
I downloaded some scenarios to enjoy myself and my favourite pattern was "The tale of the loser" by Knightmare49.
This scenario completely convinced me to start writing something on my own, so I started
I present you my scenario "A place in the world"
Before you play, I have to say that I started my scenario on the base of "The tale of the loser" and I planned in future to replace all that part to completely gave you a full 100% work made by me

I finished some pacts and I was planning to expand them a lot in the near future. This is the first time that I write something and I'm curious about your thoughts and suggestions

p.s: Sorry for my bad English, but it is difficult to keep it at an acceptable level if it is not used everyday



UPDATE 25/07/2021
Uff! We are now at the 0.8 version of this scenario, but it’s nowhere near its completion

It’s been more than two years since I was updating the files and while I was rereading my work a week ago a single thought flashed in my mind: destroy everything
Mainly I tried to correct a little bit the most incomplete point of my work: the textual parts. I don’t think I succeeded, but we’re definitely in a better situation than before. You will also notice that some routes have been updated and/or modified in view of how they will evolve

The most important thing is that I finally decided how to make my stories evolve and I just have to put them in writing. In the next updates I will focus to finish the secondary stories and then finish with the route that will connect' everything (I try to do as little spoilers as possible!). For space issues I had to change some characters with those already 'present in the game (mostly to avoid creating a file too big to handle renpy)

If you want to suggest some ideas about the paths or you catch some bugs, feel free to share in the comments or PM me
I want also to correct the grammar so if you want to help feel free to contact me


Thanks to Yousoro and C.R.E.A.M. for Sayaka's images
Thanks to BSA98 who corrected my bad grammar in the first lines
And thank you for "wasting your time" reading these confusing lines of mine

Finally, I would love to have your feedback
https://strawpoll.com/6hh9fc9j1

description_html:
"The summer festival is an annual holiday John, and now his friends, take part in. But with the discovery of a strange remote, things are about to change..."

Hello there! I guess it was finally time to update the thread...

Even though I joined the development team around this time last year, I still have to take care of this fun little project of mine. Most the time I spend on ST related stuff goes for making new content for the main game, so scenarios tend to get a little less attention. Hence the lack of updates for Festival up until now.

I started writing this last year and I've been gaining a lot of writing experience from this and the core game since then. There are still lots of things I want to change and add, but that will have to be one step at the time.
If it's the first time you're playing this, I hope you enjoy it and have a very pleasant read.

For those seeking for new content... You'll have to wait a little longer
I wanted to release the v4 compatible version once I was done with the fixes and a decent amount of new content, but I honestly didn't know when it was going to be ready. So I thought the best, for now, would be at least porting the scenario as it is from v3.1 to v4.5. (Thanks, Atsuraelu!)


About the scenario:

- There is the main storyline, which for now is the longest route available, but yet there are some choices to make.
- There are only a handful of sexually explicit scenes. I'm more into writing about the situation and not the sexual act itself.
- Feel free to look at the code and to comment on what you think about it, what would you like to happen, or what funny/bizarre situations can come out of what already happens!

title: Awkward Extension
description:
Note: Support for this scenario has been discontinued, and as such it will not be receiving further updates. In light of this, download links have been removed; this was more of a trial run, and not something that I want to stand as testament to my production style for people who haven't seen my writing before.

Thank you for your understanding, and please, feel free to try my other scenario "The Heaven We Were Promised" instead!





Content "tags:" MtF, FtM, mental changes, partial identity loss, nonsexual (e.g. no explicitly erotic scenes and generally PG-13 content), slice-of-life, almost vanilla, romantic

Hello, all!

I have a relatively brief (~54 min) long scenario preview of sorts for you. The title, "Awkward Extension," comes from an old name for the ending of the Kat Date Route where you choose not to "explore" Kat's body (Awkward Moment). If you follow the flowchart below and reach the point now labeled "Possible Relationship," you'll reach my scenario.

https://nigmabox.files.wordpress.com/20 ... wchart.png

In order, this is what you have to do to access this scenario in its intended form:

1) Obtain a copy of Student transfer v. 4.x.
2) Start the game once. Enter options and tick the box that reads, "Allow Scenario Popups."
3) Close the game. Download the scenario .zip folder here: [LINK REMOVED]
4) Install the scenario either by extracting the .zip to the scenarios folder in your Student Transfer install manually, or by using the install tool native to Student Transfer.exe.
5) Progress to the "Possible Relationship" Placeholder marker on the flowchart, click on the popup that appears at the end, and proceed as normal.

Please don't try to access the scenario by choosing it on the main menu. It's not set up for that yet.

Be aware that there is no choice in this scenario in its current form, only the illusion of choice. This is to say, while you will see menus and options, only one choice in each menu actually leads to new content.

I anticipate putting out updates for this scenario in the very near future, as it isn't my intention that it remain this brief for very long. I'm mainly doing it at this juncture to receive some general feedback and to gratify myself for what I've done thus far.

Thanks, all! I hope it's enjoyed, scant though it may be for the time being.

~ Lotus (a.k.a. PhaseJumps on forum)

title: The Heaven We Were Promised
description: After an apparent alien encounter, John receives a mysterious book that can transform his body. Experimenting with its magic draws him into shifting identities and gradual mental changes while bringing him closer to Setsuna and other classmates.
description_html:
Content Tags: Setsuna, John, Vanilla-like, OC, Slow Mental TF, Magic-Alien Hybrid Route, Romantic, Non-sexual, (Partially) Voluntary, Permanent/"Stuck"

Hello everyone!

I have a moderately-sized (~ 2hr) scenario for you this time. The tone, assets, story, character interpretations, and many other facets of this project take much more liberty with canon than my previous scenario, Awkward Extension. The most prominent of these features is the inclusion of an OC that doesn't exist in canon named "Kanade Chisaka-Jingyi," a Junior at Tina Koya High who is a year ahead in most of her classes. She's the primary swap for now, though there are others scattered around.

In writing this, I have only focused on one route; to wit, there's not a lot of actual choice in this scenario as of now. If that bothers you, maybe hold off until the content is a bit more robust some months in the future. If, however, you want to explore what's currently here, then I wholeheartedly encourage you to give it a go.

I should reiterate that this is a non-sexual, rather serious scenario and thus not for everyone.

In order, this is what you have to do to access this scenario in its intended form:

1) Obtain a copy of Student transfer v. 4.2.
2) Download the scenario .zip folder here: https://puu.sh/DfN1P/58a0bbeb60.zip
3) Install the scenario either by extracting the .zip to the scenarios folder in your Student Transfer install manually, or by using the install tool native to Student Transfer.exe. (The folder will be located at C:\Users\YourName\Desktop\Games\Misc\StudentTransfer\StudentTransfer-4.2-pc\game\scenario if you didn't change it from the default.)

Unlike Awkward Extension, this scenario may be freely accessed from the main scenario list in the startup menu of ST.

Thank you! Please enjoy.

~ Lotus (a.k.a. PhaseJumps on forum)

title: John, Interrupted
description:
Hello! This is the thread for my scenario, "John, Interrupted."

It's my attempt at taking off from a slightly modified version of the final choice on Day 4 of the Remote route.

John, Interrupted V0.2.1.
--No requirements since it uses all vanilla assets. It doesn't have a hook, so please start it from the scenarios menu.

--It's got a bit over two days so far, with one major route choice and a single (fairly boring and hard to find) ending.

--If the middle number goes up, it means there's a new full day. Crossed out choices are stuff I thought would be neat but have no plan for. If you click on one, you'll get a little message about why the choice is there before the game assumes you picked the other option. I plan on writing each choice of the plan I've got to the end of the day before I post a middle number version.

--The only thing I'm... kinda... confident about is my writing. The animations look... okay, but I'm positive I screwed up facial expressions since I can't see very well.

--I wrote it entirely based on V4.3, so Holly's mid-retcon character strangeness is being used as a plot point.

-It started out mostly involving John, Holly, Sandra and Genderbending, but the important cast is growing kinda rapidly, which is probably a bad sign.

-I broke a variable in the last version, so you might want to play through the first day again real quick.

So yeah. That's all. Here it is, please tell me what you think.

Hi there, for a while now I have been playing everyone's scenarios. And they are awesome! so I decided to have an attempt at making one for myself.
be warned that I have never attempted to code before so this is my first "project" I have ever done on coding.
if there are any spelling mistakes I have made. I'm Sorry and please point them out so I can edit it and make them better.

So, what is the route about you may ask? Well, the lack of clarity in this title is purposeful. I wanted a multiple branching routes where the players can decide what story or route they can follow. This is still a major work in progress.

When John gets hit with a remote, John discovers he has been placed in the possession of an all-powerful remote. He is yet to know where this remote came from or who threw it at him. All he knows is that he wants to enjoy his time with this remote to the best of his abilities. In his thought he decides he might try to fix some problems within his life. But will his attempts with the remote be a blessing or a curse?

The Scenario is highly incomplete at the current time.

title: Who She's Always Been
description:
Hello everyone, here is my very first scenario. Please feel free to critique it as best as you can so I can improve it for possible future releases. Not all paths are done, but most are. The scenario is more of a collection of short stories rather than a choice-based experience, so you'll choose a path in the beginning and pretty much read it to completion, featuring swift changes in both appearance and personality (Very heavy on identity death).

Synopsis:
Justin wakes up with no time to get ready for school. Luckily, a demon with absolutely no ulterior motives offers to transfer him into the body of someone else, either at school to learn what he'll miss, or someone else and skip class entirely! Naturally, Justin ignores the fact that deals such as this have massive consequences, including but not limited to: fully becoming the person he possesses, becoming corrupted with demonic energy, or being transformed into whatever the demon decides will be funny.

This scenario includes content from:
ZEB Character Pack: https://www.tfgames.site/phpbb3/viewtop ... 72&t=10701

description: Explore a sprawling magical manor where encounters with its guests and servants can lead to body swaps, possession, transformations, altered identities, and many branching fates.
description_html:
Hi everyone,
This is my second scenario, following the unfinished Who She's Always Been. This is a completely different scenario I've been working on for a while, and although it's not done yet, I'd like to share what I have so far. As of now, several endings are complete, although there is barely any music or sound effects. Even so, I hope you enjoy what I have so far.

Plot

You play as Kazuto, a man trying to get home from work, when your car breaks down in front of a mysterious manor. Meeting several other guests along the way, you can team up with them as you try to avoid becoming a part of the manor's staff members. Many choices can result in major changes, such as a potential ally becoming a member of staff that you may need to save later on. As you experience the goings-on of the manor, you can't help but wonder: who is the master of the house, and how does she command such unwavering loyalty from her staff?

Notable tags - Identity death, twinning (Most of the staff looks quite similar), mental changes, M2F, F2F, body swapping, possession, monster girls

Sooooo...long time fan, first time coder. Never done anything like this before (you can tell, this is my first ever post on TFGS...), however I love this game and a lot of the scenarios I've played, so I thought I'd have a go for myself.

Popular

Well, after a long time debating on should I finish this or not, here it is.
It's not your usual Scenario as it deals with a very niche topic, Head Swap.

OVERVIEW

An alien expeditionary force does some tests on a small town, will a social experiment on this small town cause it to rise above, or crumble under pressure....

Main Characters: Zoey, Mel, Sayaka, John and Carrie.

SPRITES

I edited and head swapped almost all of the Student Transfer's character, I only included the sprites used in this build of the scneario.

Most of the sprites used in this scenario are self edited and some of them are janky but most of the bodies are from other scenarios and packs like:
NEVER by C.R.E.A.M
Brespack: Assortment of random sprites
And other random sprites either edited by me or people from the ST Discord, so thank you for that.

Special Thanks to brespems for not only helping with the story, special CG work, editing sprites and outfits and playtesting.

As it is usual for Student Transfer scenarios the grammar and vocabulary might not be the best, but that's par for the course here, I used to Write captions and stories on my blog/Devaintart/Brawna.org/Writing.com and other forums and sites back in the day, but I stopped as I was getting burnt out, so I didn't write for the genre since 2015 for captions and short stories and since 2011 for longer more elaborate stories, so forgive me for being rusty a little bit

My Arch Nemesis

Two sworn enemies are exposed to an unnatural phenomenon that brings them closer than anyone can imagine. How will they deal with the consequences?

[[Download link]]

This scenario requires version 4.5 or 4.6 of Student Transfer to be played. Anything earlier will result in multiple errors due to missing assets in the main game.

Information:
Spoiler:
This scenario is completed. Please be aware that this does not contain anything lewd at all (unless you consider a girl in underwear lewd). This is a conscious choice and saying that you would like more lewdiness is likely going to be ignored. Sorry, but it simply isn't my style.

The average playtime is according to the game about 4.5 hours. However, it could take longer than that if you aren't a fast reader, so be prepared for that.

How to install:
Through the Install Scenario option:
1. Download the file above
2. Press "Install Scenario" in the scenario menu of the game.
3. Select the downloaded file.

Manual:
1. Download the file above
2. Extract the file inside the .zip file in the download link.
3. Place it in the scenario folder, which can be found in your main Student Transfer folder under game/scenario.

Flowchart of the scenario paths:
Spoiler:


Yes, that is right. There are no choices in this scenario. It reads more like a book than a choose-your-own-path story. This is a self-contained story and I am of the belief that choices can help bring down the quality of a scenario. Because there are no choices, this is a fully completed scenario, and asking for an update will be your actual death sentence.

I swear, if someone asks for an update I'm going to cancel something.
To other scenario developers:
Spoiler:
Installing this scenario brings a lot of assets with it. However! That doesn't mean you should redirect people to install my scenario just so that they can use assets unique to this scenario!

Be sure to check your own scenario and import the assets found here into your own folders. Your scenario should never require this scenario to be installed.

Hey peeps, I'm Hizack, a nobody that's (not) writing a scenario.
I'm no writer nor coder, along with English not being my native tongue, don't expect fancy tricks and crazy effects.
Scenario is certified not lewd, I don't trust myself to write something like that, and this is more of writing practice. I doubt I'll ever do it as anything other than a small hobby.
This episode, I wanted to write a shorter route to wind down and ended up with one that is pretty much as long as the last one. I can't write short, apparently.
Aye, that's as far as I'm going, I'd say.

To access the new content: Take the first choice that will lead you down the first path(should be the top one) and then pick a new choice that shows itself(should be the bottom one).

Overview

Follow Irene Virelles through a normal day of her life, until things stop being so normal, forcing her and her best friend Allison to take actions they may regret.
Expect huge mistakes, confrontations, breaking of friendships, wildly inaccurate characterization for side characters with no content, and some that actually have content.

When will it be finished

When pigs fly. Either that or someone else does it, I don't know.

title: Power and Temptation
description: An anthology-style scenario about students gaining coercive or supernatural power and facing the temptation to misuse it. Available routes include branching choices involving mind control, revenge, humiliation, possession, and shifting school rivalries.
description_html:
Hello everyone! First time poster, long time lurker. I decided to make an attempt at writing up a scenario for ST, I do hope you all enjoy. It is incomplete at the moment. I started ambitiously and wanted to write out a story for a few different characters, so it is very likely that a lot of what is seen in here will be scrapped, abandoned, or changed. It's already out of hand and I've fallen into the trap of too many choices without direction, but I'll figure it out as I go. Decided to upload what I have to see what people think and to see if any of my work actually works. I don't code, don't know how, tried learning on multiple occasions and have failed on each one, so, hopefully this time is different. The writing may feel like it changes time to time. I'm the sort of writer that has to do his writing in a single sitting when the inspiration hits him. Longer pieces tend to fall apart easily because if I am distracted or if I return to the piece later I will not be in the same mood as when I had originally written the piece. It is something I'm prone to, and because of such I've always kept to writing shorter pieces. I've been trying to work on a novel, so this is also practice to get over that hurdle. Furthermore, my writing style isn't really good for the whole lighthearted school setting, lol, so it may feel a bit cringe, plus my dialogue needs a lot of work. So in other words, feel free to tear this to shreds, as I'm open to criticism and welcome it. With my excuses out of the way, I hope you enjoy what I put together.

Overview:

Currently only the John choice at the start of the scenario will have any real content, Allison will have some to give you a gist of where I was going with it. Essentially what I enjoy most from Student Transfer is the power dynamic, this almighty object or magic just landing in the palms of someone who may or may not think of the ethical quandaries that come with it. So really what I want to get to is how does each character deal with wielding ultimate power, ergo the title Power and Temptation. The Allison choice is for my own amusement and will be my poor attempt at comedy. The John choice is more serious and how John tries to deal with his magical powers. This scenario will mostly contain mind control, possession, and the like. There will likely be little body swap in the future, not too sure yet. Will add to this as things get added. If you're wondering as to what I was going to do with the other characters I have listed, I'm not too sure yet. I do have something in mind for Sayaka though, which will likely be a culmination of all the stories so that will be completed last, once I figure out what I want to do with the rest, lol. As for Cornelia and Irene, probably something in relation to Sayaka, may be scrapped, depends on how I feel about it down the road.

Do note: There is no sound, no music, and a lot of animations and face changes are probably going to be missing. I suck at the whole image thing, so expect this scenario to be fairly plain. I intend on fixing it up eventually, but it's low priority for me as I prefer to write.


Current Version: 0.1.2

In the current version I added more to the John path, particularly with the argument with Katrina, Sayaka, and John. This was written months ago. I stopped working on the scenario due to real life commitments as well as the expected release of v5. I wanted a better feel of the characters before I go and change them to my whims and desires. I think my current caricatures are for the most part believable in the current canon, however, perhaps Sayaka would not be as devious as I portray her here, however, I think I like what I have going for Sayaka. Sayaka is my Machiavelli in this project of mine. And well hopefully that comes across as I want it to with this tiny update.I did run the scenario on v5, it seems to work just fine and had no issues with it, but do so at your own risk because I won't be able to bugfix it lol. It of course works with v4.6 as that's the one I made the scenario on. I'll be redoing the entire scenario on v5, most likely keeping the John path I have thus far as after reading what I had today, I liked where it was going and just need to tweak a few things. Please tell me what you all think as I'll be working on version 0.2.0. That will be my next release, which should hopefully contain at least one ending lol. That is my goal before I release another update to have one ending. I don't know what else was added to this update, but based on Renpy I added roughly 20 minutes of reading apparently, although I doubt that is actually the case.

This story is very interesting, to say the least. It, intentionally or unintentionally, asks some questions about gender and approaches what identity entails from multiple perspectives. I like Jane stories, and I do like stories of this nature as well, but:
Spoiler: 
Of course you are the one writing this, not I and I enjoyed it quite a lot. But just mentioning a personal preference stemming from kind of a moral point.

Spoiler:

description_html:
This story is very interesting, to say the least. It, intentionally or unintentionally, asks some questions about gender and approaches what identity entails from multiple perspectives. I like Jane stories, and I do like stories of this nature as well, but:
Spoiler:
I really hope that John gets "resurrected" somehow. I mean, I think there is a clear way to have Jane stay as herself while "recreating" John and that is the cloning spell, and it creates a lot of interesting questions about identity as well, is recreated John still John? But it is still better than killing John off completely. I really don't enjoy it when identity disassociation stories get rid of one of the identities, which is basically the equivalent of killing, after all that talk about how these identities are still alive, and present it as "good enough" endings.
Of course you are the one writing this, not I and I enjoyed it quite a lot. But just mentioning a personal preference stemming from kind of a moral point.
Spoiler:
Of course there is also the fact that John is a character for whom exists a lot of stories, where he largely preserves some consistency of character, so I (and many others) interacted with him a lot, and as much as he is a fictional character him being killed feels wrong somehow.

Edit: I like that Anagnorisis scenes don't happen in a way more painful than they should be happening.

description: After Tori resists John's hypnosis and discovers his magical abilities, a desperate proposal leads them into a lasting body swap. John’s new life expands into further transformations, possessions, altered realities, and complicated encounters with friends and family.
description_html:
In this scenario John decides to go up to the school roof to be able to read his book in peace…unfortunately he doesn´t notices that Tori went up to the roof too to blow off some steam where she sees him, mocks him a bit and then steals his book.
John, now in a critical situation, decides to cast a hypnotic eyes spell to bring Tori into trance to give him his book back.
But strangely Tori breaks the trance, smacks John with his book and demands and explanation so John tricks her to get his book back and flee which works.

After school John just wanted to go back home where he gets a message from Tori which tells him to wait at the front gate.
John fears that she´ll do whatever to him waits for her and after appearing Tori demands from John that he shows her that he´s a wizard which he does and after that Tori offers her body and life to him, saying that her life is crap and complaining about it, sounding serious with this.
John then is baffed and doesn´t know what to say but after a few minutes of thinking and regaining and sorting his thoughts, he completely rejects it and tells her that she should try to fix her life by herself.
They discuss it for a bit and both come to the idea that she should try it for a week and then they would meet up at the same spot to see if it worked...if it did they would proceed as normal and Tina Koya High would have one more good student and Yui maybe would stop scolding her, but if it doesn´t works John would take over her body and life. (which was planned that it doesn´t works).

After that there would be a time skip of one week and the davis family would sit at the dining table in the early afternoon, John and Holly had started to reform their brother-sister bond and they would talk about that and Sandra offers to celebrate it by ordering Pizza...they both agree and Sandra orders the Pizza...minutes later it rings on the doorbell and John says he opens the door (essencial for the next event) and sees Tori in an Pizza delivery uniform holding the pizza and is surprised to see her like that and asks her why she works as a pizza delivery girl...Tori says that she tried to fix her life by doing a job after school and already buyed non torned clothes (uniform plus normal clothes) and tried to be a good student and to keep herself and her apartment (dunno where she lives) clean and herself out of problems, but failed and fell deeper into the pit and brings up the deal they made the week earlier...John tells her that he still can´t do it and offers her to swap bodies for three days with him so she can get a different perspective... Tori thinks about it but then accepts it and the swap.
After doing it John finds out that he´s more energetic, youthful and have more mana so he can cast more spells.…his mom and sister had seen it and the three look at eachother, sit down at the table, eat the pizza slowly and silently and then everyone goes into their own room and the next day they look silently and awkwardly till one of them breaks the awkward silence and says that they need to talk it out.

After four days Tori and John meet at the same point they met 12 days before and both say that they wanna stay in the new bodies forever and both accept it…after a bit of talking and after the school they go home and John faces the fact that he needs to tell that his mom and sister…after hearing the news from John holly and sandra look at eachother but then say that they saw it coming and accepted it. And with that Johns journey of many tfs and life changes begins…

title: Magical Harem DX
description: After discovering that magic is real, John joins forces with Circe and develops his powers while a rival uses technology to reshape the people around them. The scenario mixes free-roaming choices, missions, transformations, and numerous bad endings in an unfinished contest between spellcraft and mind-altering devices.
description_html:
When dealing with a demon far beyond his understanding, John stumbles onto a completely non-canon path...
Enter a world that's dangerously close to being likely so far off character that it can barely be considered any kind of canon whatsoever, full of strange ideas that have taken my whimsy.

What is this madness?
Magical Harem DX is my slightly unhinged take on a scenario, and something I started on some time ago before being unable to continue for a variety of boring reasons.
However! I have returned with an update from the previous version I uploaded on this site.
Explore the town, using your home as a central base as you try to fix the wrongs currently plaguing the town and free your friends from tyranny.

Images:
Spoiler:



The general shape of the scenario is based on one main storyline, with various offshoots and bad endings associated with this, so please do not expect massive branching paths at this time.
I am by no means a great writer, a great storyteller... or a great scripter in Ren'py honestly, so...
Have I sold the scenario enough yet?
In all seriousness, expect some funky off-character writing, a few liberties with plot convenience and some bugs! Please report anything that you feel is broken and I will take a look. I mostly do this for fun, so I'm happy to know people have engaged with it.

Content Warnings:
This scenario currently contains strong language, one bad ending scene that implies violent 'correctional' behaviour against another, at least a couple of lines of British slang, minor voyeurism, some scenes of an explicit nature and the usual ST warnings of mind control, identity death and mild peril.

What is contained in this version?
I had been planning to write a changelog for this version (v0.2.0), but decided that due to a lot of internal changes (and I don't remember everything I have changed) it would be best to use this version as the base moving forward.
Current Content:
Spoiler:
Three main story events; Finding Kyoko, Finding Tori and Infiltrating the school
Gain power by training with Circe to unlock alternate dialogue and options (currently this allows you to easily bypass bad endings with enough training, and unlocks an additional dialogue choice)
Experience the first two random encounters; Setuna's Suspicions and Yoga Troubles
End of current content:

Recruiting Yui after the school infiltration

Author's commentary:
I've decided to add a bit of explenations about some things in this scenario. Some things that didn't make it in the story, my original intent and some more character backstory, maybe.
Spoiler:
Why is Jane so evil?
I tried to think of how each of the characters would be in an opposite universe.
- Katrina is a tomboy with a crush, but is too shy/worried to confess and is waiting on her crush to ask her out.
- Keith being the opposite, is an outgoing manly man, ready to lie to get under a girl's panties.

- Kiyoshi is an average looking boy, openly perverted, obsessed with aliens and young beautiful school girls (18+ of course)
- Kiyo, is really pretty and sexy. She has the a thing for older men, specifically with Jane's dad. And although not openly perverted like
Kiyoshi. Has some exhibitionist tendencies.

- Kyoko is smart and think things through. She's being bullied at school but figures she can just live trough it, it will eventually end.
- Kyosuke is not that smart, he let's his emotion dictate his actions and likes bullying those weaker than him.

- Holly likes her brother but feels uncomfortable around him for what I could only deduce is a fear of men. (I could be wrong, doesn't matter.)
- On the opposite side, Hiro likes his little sister too much. He wishes she would stay the little sister he always knew who like to play with him. Some more adult games maybe too.

- John has a good life. He is a good hearted dumb boy. He found this incredible power but decided to use it only to have fun with his friends.
- Jane is smart. Her life really suck though. When she found power, she realized even that bit wasn't fair because of how limited her mana was. Where John is good hearted, Jane is vengeful.
In the end, what triggered Jane's action can be summed up by this famous quote: "Absolute power corrupts absolutely"

Side characters:
- Sandra is a good mom. She wants John to date and experience life to the fulless.
- Sandro is kinda of a good dad but is too protective of Jane. He wish he could keep her home ll the time in a safe bubble so nothing ever happens to her.

- Eric and Maria / Erica and Marius: I didn't go too deep with them. They are kinda the same but Erica is the one doing most of the talking in this universe while Marius stands back and just agrees with her.

- Sayaka/Sayako: Sayako is a weak nerd. Bullied by Kyosuke. Hanging with Cornelious as his sort of man servant. Once he get the magic glasses though, his darker side comes out and becomes corrupted too.


Cutting room
Sometimes I had more ideas or details I wanted to add to the story but I was too tired or found it would not bring anything more to the story.

- Sayako got the magic glasses from a stranger who witnessed Kyosuke beating him up at the mall. A sort of enigmatic magician who wanted to give him a chance to get back at his aggressor.
I decided not to include the scene because I was too tired and wanted to move on on the main story instead.

- Keiths infidelity: In one ending where Jane caught Keith with another girl, then after learning that they would be trapped there forever Jane let Keith back into her life. Well I was supposed to expand a little bit on that. Saying something about how Keith had still cheated on Jane multiple times and how it was putting a big strain on their relationship.

The reasoning behind this branch is that Kat/Keith had a taste of being a man who can get any woman she/he wants and find it difficult to resist temptation. While on the other branch, Kat was touched by John's decision to check with her about moving out together first. And this little act was enough to secure her heart for ever (Best ending for Jane + Keith)

- Hiro's magic power: Originally, I wanted to have two ending with Hiro, one where John get's AP and one where he get's AR.
Hiro liked his sister so much when she was younger that he reverted her to her younger self. But I wanted to have some kinky stuff happen so I decided to do something else instead because of age restriction.
BTW, the AP sprite for Jane is pretty nice. I think it' still in the published scenario.

- In case it wasn't clear. If you let Kiyoshi go see Jane's dad on the first night, that's when You loose Kiyoshi. Jane's dad forced Kiyoshi to blow him. Kiyoshi resisted only a little has Kiyo's body reacted strongly to the older men's dominance and he gives in and fully embrace this side of Kiyo's life.
Later that night, While John is dreaming. Kiyoshi gets up and leave to have a "quicky" with Sandro.
The next morning they have another quick bout in the kitchen while making breakfast.

Things I regret
Only one thing: Someone pointed it out and it makes sense. When Jane enter's John's world, she cast 3 obedience spell and a body transformation one, even though I mentioned that John was almost out of mana after the portal spell.
If I was to fix something it would be that. I would have her cast only the obedience and make her "friends" come back tomorrow for the rest her vengeance.

Original ending
Originaly, when I tough of this whole story, it was going to be much darker.
John would read things in Jane's diary where she described some suicidal ideas, how she would kill some people and doodles of dead Hiro, her dad and Keith.
In the very end scene, when the switch would come. The gang would have seen, through the portal, John's body holding a bloody knife with all of the other's character's dead bodies in the room. Then after a quick gasp from everyone, Jane would have said the magic word to switch places with John.
John would have found himself back in his body, the portal closed, and quickly surrounded by policemen.
It would have ended right there.

I don't know where my head was when I though of that. I'm usually a fun/happy person. It just came to me like that.
Anyway. I'm happy with the way I ended the scenario instead

title: Butterfingers
description: John receives a reality-altering remote, but a prior alteration makes him press the wrong button and accept every unintended change as normal. His mistakes branch into chaotic body, personality, and life swaps across multiple routes and endings.
description_html:
Hello all. Here’s my scenario. I call it Butterfingers. It's a John-has-a-reality-altering-device type of story, but the gimmick is he was altered with the remote first to always use it incorrectly and not realize he's doing it. Because it's reality altering, he too will think what has changed is commonplace, and he will be under the impression that what he intended to change actually changed. Hope that makes sense, it gets a little chaotic.

It's currently ~2.9 hours in length according to the little in game description (1.1 hours more than 0.8.1). I finished every ending/added music that I envisioned for the 1.0.0 and thought I’d let it be done, but then I added more new paths currently with placeholder endings. Body swaps, reality swaps, personality swaps. A tad horny in parts, but no lewds outside of currently in-game CGs.

title: I Dream of Jane-nie
description:
Hey guys, it's been a while.

Before I get to the topic, a few things:
- English is not my first language and I mostly used DeepL for the translation.
- I'm also not really good at writing dialogue. Therefore, the whole thing could seem a bit trashy. But I would like to entertain with this story and not create a literary masterpiece.
- I wanted to offer a bit more content, but due to time constraints this was not possible. Therefore, see this version, more as a kind of concept demo.

And with that knowledge in mind, let's get to it.

I DREAM OF JANE-NIE

This scenario is a homage to the old TV show, I Dream of Jeannie.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wjL4M-OQwVg
An alternate story in the Student Transfer universe, without the alien remote or John's spell book.

Summary: During a cruise, John falls overboard and lands on a desert island. There he finds a strange bottle on the beach. When he opens it, a creature appears that disguises itself as a Djinni. From then on, John's life is no longer the same as before.

Tags:(of this Version)
Spoiler: 


Features:
- Jane as a character in her own
- Several routes, with different themes.
(Attention! This version is incomplete)

Running Time: a bit more than 3 Hours

I'm looking forward to your feedback and hope you have some fun with it.

Please note: Since I have a full-time job, I can not edit errors (if there should be any), so quickly.
The same applies to new updates / new versions.
Please be patient with me in this matter.

Thank you for your understanding.

title: Detachment
description: In a school where a weaponized remote splits students’ minds between school and home, transfer student Brooke navigates altered identities, ruthless club rivalries, cult-like pressures, and dangerous competitions. The released material focuses on branching track and cheerleader stories as she tries to survive and form connections without losing herself.
description_html:
Detachment



Overview:

In an universe where the remote has been stolen and weaponized in a new, brutal, bureaucratic system, the entire school of Tina Koya is left with their minds split between school and home. Enter "new" transfer student Brooke [last name redacted], as she struggles to adjust to strange school environment. Faced with high school cliques, aggressive competitions between clubs, and cults, Brooke must try to survive the school year with her already fractured mind intact, and hopefully make some friends along the way.

This is my first scenario after lurking for a long period of time. Not feeling completely certain about my ability to write all the characters, I decided to experiment by taking away key parts of each character and see how they functioned differently under new circumstances. Having just finished watching Severance, I thought that might be a fun little gimmick to build a story from.

That brief experiment immediately got out of hand and turned into this sprawling mess. While there's significant parts of the story that I didn't get into, I decided it would be better to focus on releasing what I had rather than risk getting overwhelmed and hitting burnout when I already let what was supposed to be a small idea get way out of hand.

Art packs from Sato's Class Swap and C.R.E.A.M.'s Never were utilized. As of the current version, the assets that I used are within the Detachment itself. If I continue with this scenario, a future update may involve reworking the scenario in a way that would require players to have Class Swap installed, to keep the scenario from becoming too bulky for its own good.

Themes and Warnings:
- Gender Bending

title: Yuuna's Story
description: John experiences life in Yuuna's body, learning about her while navigating the consequences of the swap through branching routes focused on introspection, humor, romance, and limited device use.
description_html:
Hi! I'm Cleop and I'm new here, this is my first post.
This is a little project I was working on last winter. I abandoned it, and these days I returned to it.
Now I have come up with a story that I liked and wanted to share it!
So here's my fan fiction:

Yuuna's Story

Since I played ST for the first time, I wanted to write something for it. I love writing and I found Yuuna's character interesting, so I started a story based on her; or better said, John in her body as he learns about her through her eyes.
You will find humor, romance, some explicit scenes and thoughts on the situation, but the focus is on the consequences of the swap.
There is little use of the device and more focus on John living his new life with the consequences of your choices.
Also I added a little fan service involving a few characters I like (you'll know who, I'm pretty sure of it).
This is a story that branches from the main plot, and obviously, this is not canon. I tried to respect the characters as much as possible but I took certain freedoms.

It starts from the Mem Swap Route - Hookin added since 0.2.0!:
Spoiler:
This is where John offers her mother to swap bodies with the alien device. After agreeing, Yui, Yuuna and Natsumi arrive and John offers to exchange Yui and Yuuna's body. I have written a short summary at the beginning.
Synopsis:
Spoiler:
John, in her mom's body, offers Yui (her classmate) and Yuuna (Yui's mother and his mom's friend) to exchange bodies. But he doesn't know that he pressed the button on himself before pressing it to Yuuna. As a result, John is the one who gets caught up in the situation and ends up inside Yuuna Yamashita's body.
You'll have to take decisions that will take John through crazy situations involving his new life inside Yuuna's body. From unexpected romances, personality changes, and mixed public opinions to moral, sexual, and gender identity dilemmas. You can also play rock, paper, scissors!

description:
Hello.
This is my first scenario. And basically my first attempt to write anything, so I'll take any advice and criticism and general feedback. I'm not often active on the site so excuse me if I won't answer. I will read it all and take it into account in future versions, or at least bugfixes. English is not my native language. Spoiler:

The events are sometimes shown on behalf of different characters, so you can see their thoughts. John's not the only one in this story who has an impact. The events are mainly around the swap with Yui. At least from John's side.
No sex scenes are planned yet. Sorry if that's important to you.

Hello everyone, I have been reading some scenarios and routes from the base game, after a while, I have decided to start my own. This is an Identity Death scenario, with the twist that it is written as a romantic comedy.

Plot
On this timeline, both Yui and John have started a relationship after dating for a while. One day, they find a remote that falls from the sky, and after trying to prank their family and friends, something goes terribly wrong, forcing them to accept that their lives as they knew them are coming to an end.

Overview
The idea is to explore how the process of Identity Death, treated like a terminal illness, would affect not only the two of them but also their friends and family. This scenario is not complete; currently, I'm uploading only the prologue with the objective of getting feedback on the story, characters, grammar, setting, and anything else you would like to add. Once I gather enough information or feel that I can continue with my current outline for the story, I will work on releasing the complete scenario in the next update.

This is my first scenario, and as an English second language speaker, your help is always appreciated, thank you everyone.

I've made my very first scenario. The story follows John, who wakes up in an unfamiliar body, but a world identical to his own.

Nickaholic for permission to use, and access to, their custom Jane sprite.

title: The day I lost myself
description: A long continuation of Abby's body-swap route, following John as he lives in Abby's body and confronts questions of identity, depression, strained relationships, and the consequences of mind control.
description_html:
Henlo, fellow Student Transfer enthusiast!

Dead...? I..? Absolutely not! Once again --and I ask you to forgive me for my tardiness-- I'm here with an over 4 hours update to the scenario! Please check the changelog to find out what's new (there are plenty of goodies this time :3)

As you can see in the title, due to a very likely possibility of abby's route never being finished, I decided to give it a try and write my own version of how the route could play out.

DISCLAIMER:

Given the particular nature of the route itself, I feel the need to give anyone willing to give this scenario a chance a warning: The contents of the route can and will get pretty dark once you are far enough in.
So, if you are okay with depressing and/or dark stuff, this might be for you. Regardless, I put a warning at the very start of the scenario just in case this might slip someone's notice.

SOME OTHER POINTS TO KEEP IN MIND:

[*] First of all, I'm not a native english speaker, so if you run into a typo or wonky sentences, I apologize beforehand, and I promise to be more careful in the future. Still, I have a spellchecker installed in VSCode to help with this, but some minor details are expected to slip.

[*] The contents of the scenario are roughly around four hours as the est. reading time. Though, if I'm honest, it did take me longer than that to read the whole thing.

[*] This scenario is heavily packed with text and monologue, so be aware of that (it's not a personal preference, but rather a necessary thing given the nature of Abby as a character).

[*] You are given the choice at the start of the scenario to read a brief summary I did myself on the events before the scenario starts (That is, what is written on the main game), read straight away, or read from the start of the game and reach the scenario continuation from the placeholder.

[*] Since the story is still incomplete, expect some fine tuning here and there in the future on the things that are already written thus far (honestly, there are some lines and scenes I'm not too fond of yet, but nothing major).

[*] There are currently four endings planned for the scenario: An early ending, a neutral ending, a bad ending, and a true/good ending (you can find more about this in the RPY file of the scenario, since I tend to comment a lot in there about a bunch of stuff).

[*] You can expect the next update once I'm done with the early ending. Fortunately, I'm only a few scenes away from it, so you won't have to wait long. If I had to give a rough estimation, the story is about 70% complete. Keep in mind that the contents are quite lengthy, so it's a lot more than it might seem (Specially the scene where the endings begin to branch. That one will be difficult to write...).

[*] The scenario is indeed compatible with android (I playtested it myself, so don't you worry!).

description_html:
Yes, you read the title right. I have begun to create a new version of Escape the Manor, featuring different characters and a different plot from the original, but still retaining the core theme of being trapped in a nice estate with no way out... probably. My hope is to create something more vetically tall rather than something short and wide in terms of choices and eventual endings. With that said, it's manorin' time.

I hope you enjoy v1.0, which is a length I consider to be a demo, containing nearly 20 minutes of content.

Plot

Follow John, Kiyoshi, Kat, Kyoko, Yui, and Connie on a field trip gone wrong as they find themselves stranded at an out-of-the-way manor in the mountains. Little do they know that the manor is still inhabited by the ghosts of its past, eager to integrate their souls with the still-living newcomers. Resist their influence or (more likely) give in to their invasive thoughts. Will the group escape, or will the maids and mistress rise once again?

Spoiler:






What’s new in the Fantasy World Transfer Chapter 4 update?
  • Chapter 4 Plot (2 - 3 hours):
    After months of slacking off and avoiding any real hero responsibilities, John and his friends continue the search for the next Hero’s Relic by going on vacation to Maidlan, a nation inhabited exclusively by maids, but everything is not as it seems as their carefree vacation takes a drastic turn.

    Chapter 4 Plot Spoilers
    Spoiler Level 1:
    Spoiler:
    John and his friends unwittingly get conscripted into the ongoing maid civil war. There, they learn that the Hero’s Relic may be at the center of all this, so they team up with a squad of revolutionaries in a plot to overthrow the government.
    Spoiler Level 2:
    Spoiler:
    The squad of maid-revolutionaries are struggling to climb up the military ranks. They request that John and his friends trade them one of their Divine Skill bodies for one of their video game NPC maid bodies.
    Spoiler Level 3:
    Spoiler:
    After being assigned to be the Elite guard of the central figure of this war, they find out that the identity of this central figure is none other than Jack Mallory who is using the Hero’s Relic to make himself irresistible to the opposite sex. Furthermore, he has used this magic to induct Sandra, Holly, Cassie, and Elizabeth as his personal attendants.
    Spoiler Level 4 (Lewd Scene):
    Spoiler:
    After being infected with the magic, Kiyoshi discovers that the remedy to the curse is post nut clarity. John is then reluctantly selected for a mission of espionage wherein he swaps bodies with Cassie and then performs the post nut clarity countermeasure in order to use her position to gather intel. He then learns the hard way that there are limits to the countermeasure technique.
    Spoiler Level 5:
    Spoiler:
    The person who’s in the body that John’s party traded away fails to get the intel of the countermeasure. During the final showdown with Jack, she betrays the resistance. They fight and beat Jack and liberate Maidlan.
  • New Battle Mechanics
    • MP now drains super quickly, forcing players to seriously consider resource management for themselves and their team.
    • TENSION Meter: After every turn, you gain TENSION. You also gain TENSION based on how much damage you and your team receive. Once the TENSION meter is full, you can activate an extra turn for yourself or a teammate. This significantly increases player agency, allowing you to think beyond predefined roles—for example, instead of John always spamming DPS moves, you might strategically use Kiyoshi's or another character's Divine Skill.
    • Mastered Skills: After extensive practice, John and his party can now somewhat replicate their preferred Divine Skills regardless of their current body. While not as powerful as true Divine Skills, these mastered skills are strong enough to provide viable options even with suboptimal body-mind combinations, adding a new layer of strategy to your choices.
    • “New” Enemy Moves: Some enemy moves now have unique names and animations.
    • Camera now moves to the left so you can see yourself choose your next move.
    • Allies no longer heal members who have full HP. With the sole exception being chapter 3 Riley, who does not have the combat sense to refrain from such actions.
  • New in Hiroheim Hub World
    • Scenarios in Scenarios?!
    • Michelle’s Archive: You can now explore canon offscreen adventures that just didn’t fit into the main story.
      • Setsuna’s Arrival (25 - 35 min):
        Spoiler:
        Shows off Setsuna’s arrival in Hiroeheim and how it ends up with a very strange situation for Sayaka and Cornelia.
    • Patty Oracle: You can now explore non-canon what-if situations that did not take place in the main story.
      • Reincarnation by Possession (25 - 35 min):
        Spoiler:
        John, Katrina, Kiyoshi, and Kyoko have been defeated by the spirit of the Demon King. However, their bodies have been destroyed. Now, our heroes have been granted a second chance at life by reincarnating into entirely new pre-existing bodies.
    • Rita’s Dojo: John can now train at the dojo in order to boost the STATS of his current body. Play the minigame and hit as many targets as possible. The more targets you hit, the higher your STATS grow. The minigame is optional.
    • Sayaka and Cornelia’s Boutique: John can now shop for outfits for his current body here. He can also swap between owned outfits here.
    • Tori Colosseum: Test your strength and earn big money by challenging the colosseum and potentially fighting Tori. Harder difficulty = more money.
  • New Misc Mechanics
    • All characters in the game are now theoretically valid party members, even characters from other scenarios, provided their character models are compatible (have an a-Pose).
    • fwtshow statement (character display) now supports optional arguments: position, zoom, face, and blush.
    • fwtsayoff statement: characters off screen can now show their face in the corner of the screen.
Flowchart:

Instead of having separate routes, Fantasy World Transfer will have optional side quests/stories!

Strategy Guide:
Spoiler:
In general, you want to be at least the same level as your strongest enemy before advancing to the next segment. Use your TENSION meter on Kiyoshi so he can continually top off everyone's MP.

Chapter 1
Spoiler:
Spam Titan Fist Barrage.
Only advance deep into the forest once you reach level 4.
Chapter 2
Spoiler:
Focus on healing your allies' HP and MP.
Only advance deep into Thoughtspring once you reach level 8.
Chapter 3
Spoiler:
First Oogar Fight:
Use HP Potions on John when your HP gets low.
Let your allies faint and use Brad's resurrection potions on them.
After the first Oogar fight, use the following Mind - Body combinations:
  • John - Kyoko
  • Katrina - John
  • Kiyoshi - Katrina
  • Kyoko - Kiyoshi
Spam Dragon Thunder Blast
Only advance to challenge Oogar again once you reach level 12.
Chapter 4
Spoiler:
Complete Setsuna's arrival side quest at Michelle's Archive to get the potion buff.
Really any body-mind combination is viable for the first half.
When Ran asks you for a body to trade, trade Kyoko's. It doesn't matter which one you choose to receive.
Make sure you are satisfied with your level before advancing to the promotion part. You will not get another chance to grind before the boss battle.

description: John discovers a mysterious diary whose unsigned entries describe an obsessive admirer. description_html:
Yhello.

I've been lurking on this forum for quite a bit, enjoying all the scenarios that everyone has put out for so long... only to end up freezing whenever I thought of writing my own scenario. But hey, the topics mentioned in the Scenario Jam actually helped me come up with a good idea for what I'd like to officially submit, so here it is. I've had several different ideas, like a trivia night game for the board game option and a maze-like swap class... but out of them all, this one won out in the end.

Dear Diary is a scenario that uses the topic of John finding a notebook. I'll attach the summary below.
Spoiler:
John finds a diary sitting on the ground of the shrine. He soon discovers that the diary can occasionally have an entry without a name in the end. Whatever name John attaches to that entry, reality would change to make that person to have actually written that entry.
(2.0.0 : April 30th, 2025)

I'd like to thank the7saint7 for their Holy Pack and Shika13 for their Character Pack. As of now I'm only using one character from the Holy Pack, but there is still one character from Shika13's pack in the game files meant for a future update. I will be using more characters in the future, and I already have plans for them.

I'd also like to congratulate the winners of the Scenario Jam. I honestly didn't know what to ask for as a commission, so I didn't really care much for not being nominated. Still, I'm glad to have participated, because if I hadn't I wouldn't be putting out this update now.

Anyway, now that that's out of the way, let's get on the updates. I've given more choices in this version in comparison to the Scenario Jam submission. Moreover, I've also included the more common tropes expected in a Student Transfer scenario: Gender swapping. Well, as of now there's only one body swap and one hidden F2F, but there are more coming. If anyone's interested in a sneak peek, they can look into the code. There's a lot that I've done there that hasn't been built up on.

I'll paste a more detailed explanation of the updates below.
Spoiler:
Katrina and Yui have individual endings now alongside NSFW scenes. However, they can be expanded in the future. I even have an alternate choice in the Yui route already. Additionally, I've added Sayaka as a Stalker option and Connie as a Tutor option. I have initial scenes with both, but they are not complete. In the game files, I have future expansions for the Connie Tutor path branching into a Family path and the previously mentioned Alternate Yui route. I'd like to thank all the people who've posted recommendations in the comments.
The link is posted below.
Spoiler:
https://mega.nz/file/CE5HWBZS#CszTtMK6r ... RHIWH-ynso
If anyone has any neat tricks for finding good characters to use within the character packs, please let me know.
